title: Claude Mods: Flipping the Harness Inside Out
author: Dan McAteer
description: Claude Mods is an early form of the Attention Interface. It flips the agent harness paradigm from the harness facing the machine, to the harness facing the human.
summary: For the last few weeks I’ve used Claude Mods to mold Claude Code to my AI engineering workflow. Claude Code is great out of the box, but every engineering workflow is different.
takeaways: It becomes the Attention Interface : the layer that decides when the agent interrupts you, what it shows you, and which decisions it needs you to make.
It lets you prompt the agent and the agent then sends commands, edits files and calls tools.
Claude Code has a built-in skill that teaches it how to build mods, so you can ask for the mod you want in plain language and Claude will build it.
